column3: Near-parallel deictic identification of Jahannam with the formerly rejected promise.
Adds the pattern of manifest signs being relabeled as magic despite perception.
Supplies the light-darkness parallel relevant to the focus's visibility and recognition tension.
Closest parallel: the identified Jahannam is the very object of denial.
Immediate context: nothing can repel the approaching event.
Boundary contrast of gathering into the fire; it does not establish the focus's recognition claim.
Parallels the deictic confrontation with a day previously denied.
Immediate continuation turns the magic defense into a question of seeing.
Adds the resisted-completion reading of light without resolving its relation to fire.
Makes the denied object a commanded destination, sharpening compelled verification.
Adds reception of warning as astonishment and dismissive classification.
Supplies the guidance-through-light reading alongside the focus's fire-light tension.
Directly recalls repeated recitation of signs followed by their denial.
Immediate prior scene of forcible driving toward the fire.
Connects denial of signs with lasting fire, including the disclosure-to-burning reversal.
Confirms the fire's preparation for disbelievers but adds little beyond the result.
Immediate warning names the deniers before the fire is identified.
Direct parallel joins denied fire to compelled tasting and failed escape.
Adds fire as a disclosed reality, though its setting differs from judgment on denial.
Supplies a defensive label of magic alongside rejection of the messenger.
Offers a provisional light-and-clarification parallel, not a direct fire-denial route.
Direct parallel: the denied fire becomes an inescapable tasted reality.
Immediate continuation makes entry into the fire recompense for prior deeds.
Generic denial refrain; its embodied-identity reading is secondary and already covered.
Adds exposure to fire and recompense for arrogance, without the focus's explicit denial.
Immediate apocalyptic setting, but it contributes little to the identification in 52:14.
Adds fire's fuel and a secondary light/fire reversal, though not the focus's confrontation.
The deictic challenge and sustained attachment give only a distant formal parallel.
Provides a perception-and-magic channel parallel without direct fire or denial content.
Boundary contrast supplies fire-tasting imagery, not positive support for the focus reading.
Storm peril and later invocation do not materially clarify 52:14.
Nearby creation challenge adds broad context but not the fire-denial confrontation.
Illuminating guidance contrasts with uninformed dispute, only indirectly relevant.
Its attribution dispute and mortality statement do not clarify the focus.
Offers a contrary, sought-fire scene; useful only as a secondary fire register.
Repeated denial formula is redundant after closer deictic fire parallels.
Parallels the later declaration that identifies the object previously denied.
Nearby challenge of certainty supplies little beyond local context.
Repeated woe for deniers is already supplied more directly by 52:11.
Direct command to enter the fire links present encounter to prior disbelief.
Provides a distinct inward-fire image, but its channel is not localized to the focus claim.
Offers a provisional light-loss and failed-seeing parallel.
The garden inheritance scene does not materially clarify 52:14.
Nearby reward scene does not illuminate the deniers' confrontation.
Boundary contrast concerns rescue from fire, not how the focus identifies it.
Broad denial of judgment adds only a general background category.
Adds truth arriving and then being denied, yielding confusion and defensive disorder.
Generic refrain is redundant and its auxiliary reading concerns a different scene.
Adds the prepared fire and its fuel as a secondary material register.
Nearby reward detail does not clarify the focus.
A repeated woe frame is redundant after stronger direct judgment parallels.
Links fire as abode to what was earned, adding a concise consequence frame.
Shows extraordinary visible evidence still being met with a perceptual evasion.
Links denial after delivered clear proofs with an illuminating-book parallel.
Promised garden reassurance does not materially clarify 52:14.
Mockery and the sorcery-diversion channel are too indirect for the focus.
Boundary contrast frames fire-companionship but does not positively support the focus.
Specifies denial made before adequate knowledge, sharpening the act of rejection.
The refuge-from-prompting channel does not clarify the fire confrontation.
Generic refrain is redundant and its auxiliary reading concerns particular blessings.
Adds a concrete fire consequence but not the focus's denial-recognition relation.
Directly pairs visible ascent with the claim that sight is blocked and enchantment is at work.
Repeated woe remains a redundant denial frame.
Connects disbelief and denial of signs to lasting fire, though it repeats earlier outcome links.
The protective-counterforce channel does not clarify 52:14.
Supplies a fire-as-forced-disclosure reading, while retaining its reversal as secondary.
Directly joins denial of signs and arrogance to lasting companionship with fire.
The warding channel does not clarify the focus confrontation.
Boundary contrast adds forced fire exposure but not positive support for the focus reading.
Provides a final-outcome contrast between garden and fire, without the denial moment.
Adds dispute over what is seen, supporting the recognition dimension without choosing a reading.
Light and lamp imagery supplies a remote auxiliary parallel, not a direct focus route.
Repeated woe is redundant after earlier denier refrains.
Directly pairs arrival of truth with its relabeling as magic and disbelief.
Offers only a secondary fire-as-uncovering reading of a false assumption.
Adds face-first fire and recompense by deeds, but not prior denial.
Its social-exclusion scene and channel are too distant from the focus.
Repeated woe is redundant despite its later sensory setting.
Adds a false minimization of contact with fire, a distinct form of denial.
Truth's arrival is relevant, but the status-gate channel remains indirect.
Adds fire as warning and possible boundary marker without resolving the light reading.
Clarifies that outward sight can coexist with inner blindness, central to the focus tension.
Supplies a secondary route-diversion-to-fire pattern, not the focus's direct encounter.
Adds fire as an involuntary disclosure reversal, while retaining the contrast route as boundary evidence.
Supplies a sustained garden/fire outcome contrast, though not a denial encounter.
Adds the heart's non-denial of what was seen, a parallel to recognition beyond sight.
Links concealment and denial to a light-guidance register, as auxiliary parallel evidence.
Contrasts rescue from fire with disclosed signs and guidance, without the focus's confrontation.
Status-based objection to revelation only indirectly parallels rejection in 52:14.
Adds a settled fire-outcome category but little about recognition or deictic exposure.
The demand for the promised decisive event parallels skepticism toward an announced reality.
General collective denial of messengers is already covered by more specific cards.
Adds a chosen relationship becoming a lasting fire-abode consequence.
Separates responsibility after denial but lacks the focus's fire or recognition element.
Denial of signs and arrogance receive an exclusionary outcome, a useful counter-outcome frame.
Explicitly orders receipt of signs before denial, arrogance, and disbelief.
After the matter is decided, it locates blame in response to invitation and false promise.
Links disbelief and denial of signs to humiliating consequence, extending the reversal pattern.
The awakening and provisioning scene does not materially clarify 52:14.
Directly stages standing before fire and the retrospective wish not to deny the signs.
A direct compelled acknowledgment that the encountered reality is true.
Joins denial of signs to an ensuing punishment, extending the consequence frame.
Provides reciprocal confirmation that the announced promise proved true.
Adds speech across the fire boundary after the outcome has become manifest.
Shows a leader's followers being brought to the fire, extending forced conveyance.
Supplies an immediate fire outcome after rejection and obstinacy.
Pairs entry into Jahannam with prior arrogance, a close outcome parallel.
Adds an explicitly prepared fire for those who reject, with enclosing imagery.
Depicts wrongdoers seeing the fire and recognizing their unavoidable fall into it.
Makes approach to the fire an unavoidable horizon, without resolving its scope.
Sets the fire as the consequence for arriving in guilt, with no exit into life or death.
Centers inability to avert the fire once its reality is known.
Supplies a fireward destination for false objects of devotion and their adherents.
Directly connects denial of the Hour to a prepared blaze.
Adds the fire's perceptual initiative from afar, a contrary but relevant visibility register.
Frames Jahannam as already encompassing those who disbelieve.
Stages fire covering the deniers from above and below at the moment of tasting.
Connects disbelief to a prepared blazing fire, though it lacks deictic confrontation.
Adds an enduring fire outcome for disbelievers and the failure of escape.
Combines being driven to Jahannam with the reminder that messengers delivered warnings.
Names denial of the Book and the messages as the antecedent to the fire sequence.
Completes that denial sequence with entry into the fire.
Supplies permanence in the fire after the consequence is fixed.
Near-parallel final address identifies the present ordeal as what was formerly disputed.
States denial of the promised Hour despite its asserted certainty.
Turns that prior denial into a present fire-abode declaration.
Most direct omitted parallel: exposure to fire elicits compelled recognition of its truth.
Supplies the command to cast an obstinate rejecter into Jahannam.
Adds the fire's direct address at the point of its filling.
Places deniers in error before their later dragging through the fire.
Provides a fire-based final environment as the counterpoint to the preceding blessed outcome.
Makes fire the final refuge after a failed attempt at exchange or rescue.
Connects enduring fire to a settled class whose wealth and children cannot avert it.
Links disbelief in the Lord to Jahannam as an explicitly named destination.
Makes the fire-dwellers recall having rejected the warning when it came.
Adds retrospective admission that listening or understanding would have changed the outcome.
Centers the near sight of the promised reality and its effect on disbelieving faces.
Adds a direct command to seize and expose a rejecter to the blaze.
Names the threatened entry into Saqar, a closely related fire register.
Uses a post-judgment question to connect present Saqar with prior conduct.
Links the arrival of certainty to the end of prior denial in the Saqar sequence.
Frames Jahannam as an appointed place lying in wait for transgressors.
Makes Jahim visibly brought forth for whoever sees, directly relevant to exposure.
Places the wicked in Jahim as the corresponding outcome category.
Adds entry into a blaze after the failed record encounter.
Names the greatest fire as the destination of the most wretched.
Supplies a concise entering-fire outcome for humbled faces.
States that Jahim will be seen, directly developing the focus's visual confrontation.
Intensifies that seeing into a certainty-grounded mode without selecting an interpretation.
Names the fire as kindled divine fire, adding a distinct fire register.
Applies entry into a flaming fire to a named rejecter, a concrete outcome instance.
